as_told.title: Atlantis destroyed by Meltwater Pulse 1B flood

plain: The researcher Randall Carlson points out that Plato, in his dialogues the Timaeus and the Critias, has the Greek lawmaker Solon learn in Egypt that Atlantis fell 9,000 years before his own time, around 600 BC. That puts the fall at about 9,600 BC, which Carlson says lines up with the end of the last ice age and the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell at the close of that ice age. Michels repeats it on several episodes, crediting Carlson and the writer Graham Hancock, and on one he says outright that Atlantis was destroyed by Meltwater Pulse 1B, a burst of flooding as the ice sheets melted, which would mean Plato's story preserves a real memory of a lost civilization.
